entry.summary:

8-bit Music Theory breaks down Silksong’s Bone Bottom theme by highlighting the mournful b6 interval, consistent chord progressions, the B section’s surprises, and even how the composer “sacrifices” the home key for richer harmonies—all while comparing its emotional impact to the original Dirtmouth theme. Timestamps guide viewers through each deep dive (from “The sad, sad b6” at 1:16 to the contrasting emotional approaches at 8:50 vs. 9:45), and the description plugs Patreon, merch, Discord, and Twitter for those who want to support or connect.
